_readme: Things Ben has NOT done, so the matcher can say NOT YET honestly instead of guessing.

gaps.name: LMS administration
gaps.note: Ben has used Workday Learning and Cornerstone and was Product Owner on learning platform rollouts, but he doesn't claim LMS administrator experience.

gaps.name: HRIS administration
gaps.note: Ben's Workday experience is Workday Learning, as a Product Owner. He hasn't claimed HRIS administration or configuration.

gaps.name: Recruiting and talent acquisition
gaps.note: Recruiting and talent acquisition aren't part of Ben's background.

gaps.name: Payroll, benefits, and compensation
gaps.note: Payroll, benefits, and compensation aren't part of Ben's background.

gaps.name: Employee relations investigations
gaps.note: Ben partnered with Employee Relations on programs, but he hasn't listed investigations or case work.

gaps.name: Performance management and succession
gaps.note: Performance management and succession planning aren't on Ben's resume.

gaps.name: Managing direct reports
gaps.note: Ben led a team of 4 as an ERG geo chair and project manages cross-functional teams, but he hasn't listed formal direct reports.

gaps.name: SHRM or HRCI certification
gaps.note: Ben's certifications are two ATD certificates (Project Management for Learning Professionals, and Evaluating Learning Impact) plus an MBA. No SHRM or HRCI certification is listed.

gaps.name: CPTD or APTD
gaps.note: Ben holds ATD certificates but not the CPTD or APTD.

gaps.name: SQL, Python, or Tableau
gaps.note: Ben builds AI workflows (Gemini, Apps Script, Power Automate) and works in Power BI and Excel, but SQL, Python, and Tableau aren't on his resume.

gaps.name: Statistical analysis
gaps.note: Formal statistical modeling isn't on Ben's resume.

gaps.name: DEI program ownership
gaps.note: Ben led an employee resource group, but his resume doesn't claim DEI program or strategy ownership.

gaps.name: AI governance and policy
gaps.note: Ben enables people and builds with AI. Formal AI governance or policy ownership isn't on his resume.

gaps.name: Prosci or ADKAR certification
gaps.note: Ben has change management experience (adoption work through the BMO acquisition integration), but no Prosci or other change certification is listed.

gaps.name: Other authoring tools
gaps.note: Ben's resume names Articulate 360 and Rise as his authoring tools. Ask him about anything beyond those.

gaps.name: Security clearance
gaps.note: No security clearance is listed on Ben's resume.

gaps.name: Doctorate or other advanced degree
gaps.note: Ben's highest degree is an MBA.

gaps.name: Sales or customer support
gaps.note: Sales and customer-facing revenue roles aren't part of Ben's background.
